title: GamesAndGains
description: A Fabric pack with performance boosts, exploration tools, storage, power, mining upgrades, and useful client features.
body:
This Fabric modpack improves Minecraft 26.1.2 with performance mods, visual upgrades, exploration tools, storage, power, and quality-of-life features.

It adds performance and rendering improvements through Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, Iris, Sodium Extra, Reese's Sodium Options, and Distant Horizons. These help the game run smoother, give players more graphics options, and improve long-distance terrain visibility.

It also includes tools that make survival easier to play and understand, including Jade, JEI, AppleSkin, Mod Menu, Mouse Tweaks, JourneyMap, Dynamic Lights, Armor Stand Editor, Veinminer, Universal Ores, Soft Glow Ores, Ice Boats, and Enchanted Vertical Slabs. These add recipe viewing, map navigation, better item and block information, easier inventory handling, improved lighting, and faster mining.

For storage and technology, the pack includes Refined Storage, Refined Storage JEI Integration, Energized Power, and Fabric Simple Generator. These give players simple storage, power generation, and tech progression without making the pack too large or complicated.

Download this pack if you want a smoother Fabric experience with practical tools, better exploration, convenient mining, and light tech features.

Important information before downloading:
- This pack is for Fabric.
- Use the matching Minecraft version selected on Modrinth.
- Some features are client-side only, while storage, power, world, and gameplay mods may also be needed on a server.
- Veinminer should be used only where the server allows it.
